arxiv-2102-01155.title: G-Formula for Observational Studies under Stratified Interference, with Application to Bed Net Use on Malaria
arxiv-2102-01155.creator: Kayla W. Kilpatrick, Chanhwa Lee, Michael G. Hudgens
arxiv-2102-01155.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kayla W. Kilpatrick, Chanhwa Lee, Michael G. Hudgens. Assessing population-level effects of vaccines and other infectious disease prevention measures is important to the field of public health. In infectious disease studies, one person’s treatment may affect another individual’s outcome, i.e., there may be interference between units. For example, the use of bed nets to prevent malaria by one individual may have an indirect effect on other individuals living in close proximity.

arxiv-2109-00861.title: User, Robot, Deployer: A New Model for Measuring Trust in HRI
arxiv-2109-00861.creator: 1 st David Cameron, 2 nd Emily C. Collins
arxiv-2109-00861.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by 1 st David Cameron, 2 nd Emily C. Collins. There is an increasing interest in considering, implementing, and measuring trust in human-robot interaction (HRI). Typically, this centres on influencing user trust within the framing of HRI as a dyadic interaction between robot and user. We propose this misses a key complexity: a robot’s trustworthiness may also be contingent on the user’s relationship with, and opinion of, the individual or organisation deploying the robot.

The data used are from the Large Area Telescope onboard the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (Fermi) . We detect γ \gamma -ray pulsations of the MSP at a 4.

arxiv-2408-04331.title: Enhancing Journalism with AI: A Study of Contextualized Image Captioning for News Articles using LLMs and LMMs
arxiv-2408-04331.creator: Aliki Anagnostopoulou, Thiago S. Gouvêa, Daniel Sonntag
arxiv-2408-04331.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) and large multimodal models (LMMs) have significantly impacted the AI community, industry, and various economic sectors. In journalism, integrating AI poses unique challenges and opportunities, particularly in enhancing the quality and efficiency of news reporting. This study explores how LLMs and LMMs can assist journalistic practice by generating contextualised captions for images accompanying news articles.

arxiv-2408-09057.title: Approximate Differentiable Likelihoods for Astroparticle Physics Experiments
arxiv-2408-09057.creator: Juehang Qin 1 and Christopher Tunnell 1
arxiv-2408-09057.description: Abstract Traditionally, inference in liquid xenon direct detection dark matter experiments has used estimators of event energy or density estimation of simulated data. Such methods have drawbacks compared to the computation of explicit likelihoods, such as an inability to conduct statistical inference in high-dimensional parameter spaces, or a failure to make use of all available information.

arxiv-2410-08343.title: Computing Generalized Eigenfunctions in Rigged Hilbert Spaces
arxiv-2410-08343.creator: Matthew J. Colbrook, Andrew Horning, Tianyiwa Xie
arxiv-2410-08343.description: Abstract We introduce a simple, general, and convergent scheme to compute generalized eigenfunctions of self-adjoint operators with continuous spectra on rigged Hilbert spaces. Our approach does not require prior knowledge about the eigenfunctions, such as asymptotics or other analytic properties.

arxiv-2412-09625.title: Illusion3D: 3D Multiview Illusion with 2D Diffusion Priors
arxiv-2412-09625.creator: Yue Feng, Vaibhav Sanjay, Spencer Lutz, Badour AlBahar, Songwei Ge, Jia-Bin Huang
arxiv-2412-09625.description: Abstract Automatically generating a multiview illusion, where a single piece of visual content offers distinct interpretations from different viewing perspectives, is a compelling challenge. Traditional methods, such as shadow art and wire art, create interesting 3D illusions but are limited to simple visual outputs ( i.e . , figure-ground or line drawing), restricting their artistic expressiveness and practical versatility.

arxiv-2503-23073.title: Local unitary classification of sets of generalized Bell states in ℂ d ⊗ ℂ d \mathbb{C}^{d}\otimes\mathbb{C}^{d}
arxiv-2503-23073.creator: Cai-Hong Wang 1, Jiang-Tao Yuan 1, Mao-Sheng Li 2, Ying-Hui Yang 3, Shao-Ming Fei 4
arxiv-2503-23073.description: Abstract Two sets of quantum entangled states that are equivalent under local unitary transformations may exhibit identical effectiveness and versatility in various quantum information processing tasks. Consequently, classification under local unitary transformations has become a fundamental issue in the theory of quantum entanglement.

arxiv-2512-06210.title: Forests of Uncertaint(r)ees: Using tree-based ensembles to estimate probability distributions of future conflict
arxiv-2512-06210.creator: Daniel Mittermaier, Tobias Bohne, Martin Hofer, Daniel Racek, [1ex] Center for Crisis Early Warning (CCEW), University of the Bundeswehr Munich
arxiv-2512-06210.description: Abstract Predictions of fatalities from violent conflict on the PRIO-GRID-month ( pgm ) level are characterized by high levels of uncertainty, limiting their usefulness in practical applications. We discuss the two main sources of uncertainty for this prediction task, the nature of violent conflict and data limitations, embedding this in the wider literature on uncertainty quantification in machine learning.

pmc-10557866.title: Real‐world experience of tyrosine kinase inhibitors in children, adolescents and adults with relapsed or refractory bone tumours: A Canadian Sarcoma Research and Clinical Collaboration (CanSaRCC) study
pmc-10557866.creator: Hagit Peretz Soroka, Tushar Vora, Jonathan Noujaim, Nicolas Marcoux, Sarah Cohen‐Gogo, Thierry Alcindor, Caroline Holloway, Caroline Rodrigues, Hatim Karachiwala, Saima Alvi, Ursula Lee, Sylvia Cheng, Shantanu Banerji, Sapna Oberoi, Xiaolan Feng, Alannah Smrke, Christine Simmons, Albiruni Abdul Raza
pmc-10557866.description: ObjectivesWe conducted a retrospective multi‐centre study to assess the real‐world outcome of regorafenib (REGO) and cabozantinib (CABO) in recurrent/refractory bone tumours (BTs) including osteosarcoma (OST), Ewing sarcoma (EWS) and chondrosarcoma (CS)/extra‐skeletal mesenchymal CS (ESMC).MethodsAfter regulatory approval, data from patients with recurrent BT (11 institutions) were extracted from CanSaRCC (Canadian Sarcoma Research and Clinical Collaboration) database.

pmc-10704811.title: A novel truncated variant in SPAST results in spastin accumulation and defects in microtubule dynamics
pmc-10704811.creator: Jie Wang, Yihan Wu, Hong Dong, Yunpeng Ji, Lichun Zhang, Yaxian Liu, Yueshi Liu, Xin Gao, Yueqi Jia, Xiaohua Wang
pmc-10704811.description: ObjectiveHaploinsufficiency is widely accepted as the pathogenic mechanism of hereditary spastic paraplegias type 4 (SPG4). However, there are some cases that cannot be explained by reduced function of the spastin protein encoded by SPAST. The aim of this study was to identify the causative variant of SPG4 in a large Chinese family and explore its pathological mechanism.

pmc-11309783.title: NeuroRoots, a bio-inspired, seamless brain machine interface for long-term recording in delicate brain regions
pmc-11309783.creator: Marc D Ferro, Christopher M Proctor, Alexander Gonzalez, Sriram Jayabal, Eric Zhao, Maxwell Gagnon, Andrea Slézia, Jolien Pas, Gerwin Dijk, Mary J Donahue, Adam Williamson, Jennifer Raymond, George G Malliaras, Lisa Giocomo, Nicholas A Melosh
pmc-11309783.description: Scalable electronic brain implants with long-term stability and low biological perturbation are crucial technologies for high-quality brain–machine interfaces that can seamlessly access delicate and hard-to-reach regions of the brain. Here, we created “NeuroRoots,” a biomimetic multi-channel implant with similar dimensions (7 μm wide and 1.5 μm thick), mechanical compliance, and spatial distribution as axons in the brain.

pmc-12579622.title: Escape rooms as an interactive learning experience: insights into designing a radiology-themed escape room and exit survey data
pmc-12579622.creator: Jonas Oppenheimer, Sophia Lüken, Annika Bierbrauer, Paul Kamieniarz, Martine S. Nilssen, Maurice Quang Loc Bui, Anna-Maria Haack, Mona Jahn, Katharina Beller, Yasmin Uluk, Lyel Grumberg, Markus Herbert Lerchbaumer, Timo A. Auer, Carolina Dominguez Aleixo, Laura Segger
pmc-12579622.description: ObjectivesEscape rooms provide an interactive learning experience, combining clinical knowledge with problem-solving and teamwork. A radiology-themed escape room has been organized at the European Congress of Radiology in 2019 and 2023–2025, with over 900 people participating in total. The process of developing a radiology-themed escape room is discussed, and the results of a participant survey are presented.

pmc-12594814.title: Structural and allosteric effects of the membrane-bound PI3Kα H1047R mutation and opportunities for drug discovery
pmc-12594814.creator: Danai Maria Kotzampasi, Zoe Cournia
pmc-12594814.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PI3Kα is a lipid kinase that regulates cell growth and survival via the PI3Kα/Akt pathway. As a peripheral membrane protein, PI3Kα is activated at the membrane, however, its active conformation remains unknown. To investigate how PI3Kα and its most prevalent oncogenic mutation, H1047R, interact with the membrane, we performed Molecular Dynamics simulations of active-like PI3Kα WT and H1047R mutant in complex with HRAS on a model membrane.

pmc-12755958.title: Patient Perceptions of Orthopedic Surgeon-Led Nutrition Discussions Regarding Arthroplasty Care: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
pmc-12755958.creator: Janae Rasmussen, Linda Rasmussen, Elise Rivera, Cody Walter
pmc-12755958.description: Background: Nutrition and lifestyle factors, such as low albumin, smoking, and morbid obesity, have been linked to worse outcomes after arthroplasty surgery. This study is the first, to our knowledge, to investigate the effect of orthopedic surgeon-led nutrition discussions on patient perceptions in arthroplasty care.

pmc-12802133.title: Comparison of selected metals in the fillers of 14 commercial hemp cigarette brands to commercial tobacco cigarettes
pmc-12802133.creator: Naudia R Gray, R Steven Pappas, Clifford H Watson
pmc-12802133.description: Cannabis sativa L. containing < 0.3% delta-9 tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) is currently defined as hemp. Many different legal products in the United States now contain hemp and are marketed for their cannabinoid effects, as an alternative to tobacco products, or even as an aid for tobacco smoking cessation.
